{
  "cypher": "MATCH (p:Politician)-[:holdsPosition]->(pos1:Position), (p)-[:holdsPosition]->(pos2:Position)
WHERE (pos1.name CONTAINS 'President' OR pos1.name CONTAINS 'Head of State' OR pos1.name CONTAINS 'Monarch')
  AND (pos2.name CONTAINS 'Prime Minister' OR pos2.name CONTAINS 'Chief Executive' OR pos2.name CONTAINS 'Head of Government')
  AND pos1 <> pos2
MATCH (c:Country)
WHERE pos1.name CONTAINS c.name OR pos2.name CONTAINS c.name
UNWIND c.official_language AS lang
RETURN DISTINCT lang AS official_language"
  , "rationale": "The query finds politicians who have held two distinct positions – one identified as a head‑of‑state role (e.g., President, Head of State, Monarch) and another as a head‑of‑government role (e.g., Prime Minister, Chief Executive, Head of Government). It then matches each of those positions to any country whose name appears in the position title. Finally it unwinds the array of official languages for each matched country and returns the distinct language values, giving exactly the unique official languages of all countries where such politicians have served in both capacities."
}

      toLower(pos2.name) CONTAINS 'prime minister' OR
      toLower(pos2.name) CONTAINS 'chancellor' OR
      toLower(pos2.name) CONTAINS 'premier' OR
      toLower(pos2.name) CONTAINS 'minister‑president'

    (
      toLower(pos1.name) CONTAINS 'prime minister' OR
      toLower(pos1.name) CONTAINS 'chancellor' OR
      toLower(pos1.name) CONTAINS 'premier' OR
      toLower(pos1.name) CONTAINS 'minister‑president'

      toLower(pos2.name) CONTAINS 'president' OR
      toLower(pos2.name) CONTAINS 'monarch' OR

      toLower(pos2.name) CONTAINS 'emperor'
